[list]
[*] More lasers have been added to medium and large maps
[*] The lasers have been made a little stronger
[/list]

New:
[list]
[*] New achievement has been added
[*] Fake platforms have been added
[/list]

The fake platforms can be switched off and on under Game Settings.
By default, the fake platforms are enabled.

notes.title: Straight Up Tutorial Update
notes.content:
[u][b]Update:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Drops UI has been added
[*] A way point for the end has been added
[/list]

In this update, the tutorial has been improved. Now you can see how many drops need to be collected and how many you have already collected. Furthermore, an additional waypoint has been added so that you know where to go after collecting all the drops.
